_comment: Plants a ProjectileBomb 1 unit ahead along the caster's last walking direction, not cursor aim. It arms over 45 ticks then waits, detonating when an enemy wanders in, or expiring after 900 ticks if nothing does. A mine versus a timed bomb is decided purely by authoring ttlTicks well above or just above armTicks. A caster who never walked gets the bomb at their feet. All placeholder.
name: ThrowMine
